#summary About the AmFast project.
= !AmFast =

 * !AmFast is developed and maintained by [http://bcf.arl.arizona.edu/dave-thompson/index.php Dave Thompson].
 * Several patches have been accepted from the !AmFast community.
 * If you're interested in helping out with the project, send a message out to the [http://groups.google.com/group/amfast/web/amfast AmFast group]

= Thanks =

These projects did it first and gave great implementation examples:

 * [http://pyamf.org PyAmf]
 * [http://www.teslacore.it/wiki/index.php?title=AMFEXT AMFEXT]
